cd /workspace/project && timeout 300 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,subprocess,time
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
def bal():
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/get_user_balance",headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30) as x: return json.load(x)['balance']
b0=bal()
sysmsg="You are Hermes, a helpful personal AI agent with memory. "*200
total_cost=0
for i in range(5):
    b=json.dumps({"model":"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored",
      "messages":[{"role":"system","content":sysmsg},{"role":"user","content":"Tulis 300 kata tentang sejarah Indonesia."}],"max_tokens":800}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=180) as x: d=json.load(x)
    total_cost+=d['usage']['cost']
    print(f"  [{i+1}] prompt={d['usage']['prompt_tokens']:5} compl={d['usage']['completion_tokens']:4} cost=${d['usage']['cost']:.6f}")
time.sleep(3)
b1=bal()
print(f"\nsaldo {b0:.4f} -> {b1:.4f} | delta nyata=${b0-b1:.6f}")
print(f"total cost dilaporkan = ${total_cost:.6f}")
print(f"=> saldo TIDAK berkurang walau cost dilaporkan ${total_cost:.4f}")
PY
